description_text: The idea behind this entry was to focus on something wearable that was also multi-functional.  They swivel on a ring shaped plug and joining pin that the wearer can thread onto a chain or necklace.  The Multi-Cards are designed to take on different functions based on the users needs.  One is an ID card with important information about the owner.  Another is a money storage card with a removable door.  Last there's a multi-tool card that can accept standard razor blades, a nail for a scribe and even a bottle opener.  These are just a few ideas for the Multi-Cards and more can be added.  Each card is about 1/10'' thick, the money card being 3/10''.  In total there is about 45 grams worth of plastic with the three cards and the plug/pin that holds them together.

It was originally manufactured and sold by Taito in Japan, and was later licensed for production in the United States by the Midway division of Bally. Space Invaders is one of the earliest shooting games and the aim is to defeat waves of aliens with a laser cannon to earn as many points as possible. It was one of the forerunners of modern video gaming and helped expand the video game industry from a novelty to a global industry. When first released, Space Invaders was very successful and popular. Following its release, the game caused a temporary shortage of 100-yen coins in Japan, grossed US$2 billion in quarters by 1982, and by 2007 had earned Taito over $500 million in profits. Guinness World Records ranks it the top arcade game.  The game has been the inspiration for other video games, re-released on numerous platforms, and led to several sequels. The 1980 Atari 2600 version quadrupled the system's sales and became the first killer app for video game consoles. Space Invaders has been referenced and parodied in multiple television shows, and been a part of several video game and cultural exhibitions. The pixelated enemy alien has become a pop culture icon, often used as a synecdoche representing video games as a whole.

description_text:
High resolution, high-quality emergency button. photorealistic.
A kill switch, also known as an emergency stop (E-stop), emergency off (EMO), and emergency power off (EPO), is a safety mechanism used to shut off machinery in an emergency when it cannot be shut down in the usual manner. Unlike a normal shut-down switch or shut-down procedure, which shuts down all systems in order and turns off the machine without damage, a kill switch is designed and configured to abort the operation as quickly as possible (even if it damages the equipment) and to be operated simply and quickly (so that even a panicked operator with impaired executive functions or a bystander can activate it). Kill switches are usually designed to be noticeable, even to an untrained operator or a bystander.

Experience flow
Hand-product interaction is everything while drawing and creating. Feedback from the tool through our hand allow our thoughts to flow to the drawign and create the lines we envision.
The Apple Pencil is great as an interaction tool. What many complain about is the hand-object connection. The Pencil for some is too smooth and slippery. The iGrip will assist in ugrading and improving the experience. Its ergonomic 3 sided shape, soft organic surfaces will take hand-pencil interaction to a new level. It will not slip, the grip will be consistent and natural. Sketches, ideas, actions will flow without strain.
About this product:
Ideal if you naturally hold your pen with 3 fingers (tripod grasp).    Designed for right and left handed.    Open shape with a thin soft groove, that way it acts as a flexible spring allowing minor issues with 3d printing precision. It also makes it easy to pull in and out or to adjust its position.
Please let me know what you think!
Setup for printing is very easy, best quality in 0,1mm resolution recommended, polish for a smoother experience.

description_text:
Many reviews about the iPad Pro and Apple Pencil comments the missing integration between the Pencil and the iPad while moving around and even while in use. You have the magnets but they are not strong and safe enough so you risk dropping the quite costly Pencil. The Smart Clip intend to close this gap integrating this devices in a simple solution.  
Smart Clip, 3 in 1:
It holds securely the Pencil on the side or to any border of the iPad. Great while on the go!The clip can be used as front camera cover for privacy. Make some for family and friends!The Smart Clip element holding the Pencil is also the grip to release the clip from the iPad. Just pull off the pencil and gently press to release the clip from the iPad.
Other smart uses:
Use the Smart Clip to hold papers, convenient for sketching    It may work on notebooks screens, other tablets and with other pencils.    The clip grips to the iPad with or without the Smart Cover on. Not tested with the smart keyboard or silicone case.    On the short side of the iPad is the optimal position as the clip will not cover any screen area.
Comfort and durability: The clip has been designed making it easy to open with a soft, ergonomic amount of pressure.
Please let me know what you think! Thank you
Easy to print on its side, no supports necessary, make it in the highest quality possible, sand lightly for smoothest experience.

description_text:
TV Studio Spot Light 3D Model. 3 objects (base, lens, emitting surface), each one with its own non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
3 Objects (meshes), 3 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 20266 vertices, 20204 quad faces (40408 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Game ready low poly model of electronic display with glowing numbers.
The model has 3 sets of textures for Realtime engine (spec/gloss), vray and numbers for self-illumination (emessive map). Also there is a psd file with numbers for change color as you like. You can use subdivision for the glass. For correct render you shoild use the modifier of thickness (e.g shell)
Geometry was checked for bugs, overlapping faces and vertices and etc. Originally modelled in 3ds max 2014. Materials created for vray 2.40. Rendered for preview in Marmoset and Vray
Textures are 2K
For real time engine: 

  - Albedo - Albedo_Trancparancy (with Trancparancy in alfa chanel) glass 

  - Gloss 

  - Specular 

  - Specular_unity (with gloss in alfa chanel) for unity 

  - Roughness 

  - Normal 

  - ID + psd 

  - Trancparancy 

  - Emessive (set of numbers 0-9)

For Vray(3d max): 

  - Diffuse 

  - Normal 

  - ID 

  - Reflect 

  - rGlossiness 

  - Opacity (Not use) 

  - Refract

Polys: 101 Tris: 188 Verts: 118
File formats: 

  - 3d Max 2014 (vray 2.40) 

  - 3d Max 2011 

  - OBJ 

  - FBX 2006 and 2014 versions 

  - 3DS 

  - Unity package

If you have a question or problem with my models, let me know. I'll fix it.
Thank You!

| Model Context|This water boiler/cooker is made in Blender 2.78.5, using the - currently new - Principled Shader from Blender to use with exports from Substance Painter, in which the materials were made. The model can be used in broadcast, advertising, realistic (game) environments. Model is built to real-world scale - the unit system is metric – and has a height of approx. 32 cm.  No third-party renderer or plug-ins needed, just Blender (from version 2.78.5, with the Principled BSDF shader).
| Mesh Specs |Model is subdivision ready. 
Original: Vertices: 18364Polygons: 18052
Highpoly (Subdiv 2):Vertices: 99638Polygons: 99006
| Texture Specs |Materials were created in Substance. For the lowpoly and Subdiv 2 textures are included for PBR Metal/Rough (BaseColor, Roughness, Metallic and Normal) and texturesets for Unreal Engine 4 and Unity.Render setup for Blender: the materials are setup in Cycles (see the presentation images for examples of Blender (Cycles) renders. They are setup using the Principled BSDF shader. Included textures: Texture sets are added for Unreal Engine 4, Unity 5 and PBR (metallic/roughness). 
| Included file formats |

  - .BLEND

  - .FBX

  - .OBJ

  - .DAE

  - .PLY

  - .3DS

  - .STL

  - .ABC

description_text:
Guitar equalizer control panel 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 3397 vertices, 3298 quad faces (6596 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Desk microphone 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 13261 vertices, 13170 quad faces (26340 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Batteries pack 3D Model. 9 individual objects (9v, 4.5v lantern, AA, AAA, AAAA, CR14, CR2032 button coin, D flashlight, LR44 button cell), sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
9 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 14682 vertices, 15015 quad faces (29320 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
SD memory card 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 21553 vertices, 21471 quad faces (42942 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
• Let me present to you simple low-poly 3D model of MP3 Player Direc F1805. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real player that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of one mesh, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• The total of the main textures is 1. Resolution of texture is 2048 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. 
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
EPROM (Erasable Programmable Read Only Memory) chip - 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 29352 vertices, 29292 quad faces (58584 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Electronic resistors 3D Model. 3 objects, sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
3 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 16566 vertices, 16560 quad faces (33120 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

by Ufuk Orbey (shadedancer619) / Improved in: Cinema 4D R19

dishes(source).C4D is the main file for Cinema 4D users. Two dishes placed together in the file. No textures on it but has a good UV to ready your materials.

=============================================================================================================================
RAR FILES:
SEPERATED.RAR has an individual models of two antennas (dish01 and dish02) in OBJ, FBX, DAE, 3DS formats.
=============================================================================================================================
TEXTURES:
Only the Cinema 4D source file has no textures. Other formats have a good UV maps and materials on them. Materials are prepared and textured in Substance Painter.

=============================================================================================================================

description_text:
When i got my printer i wanted to print a case for my power bank. Since Xiaomi is not a famous company i could not find a single model that would work with my 20000 mAh power bank.So i decided to create one myself.The power bank fits great and even without the cap the power bank will not fall of the case even when being held upside down.Its easy to get it out with a push and the cutout is pretty handy to check the battery level on the go.The cap is designed outside the case and to provide access to all ports (1 X  micro USB for charging and 2X USB Type A for powering your devices. Also the cap is made so you can see the battery indicator so you never have to guess about the charge of the power bank.
Power Bank Case Specs1) 1.5 mm thick walls and bottom 2) Tight fit so it can be used without the cap3) Power Level Button cutout to check the battery level without having to take the power bank out of its case
Cap Specs1) Accessibility to all ports2) Accessibility to battery level indicator LED's3) Tight fit with the case 4) 1.5 mm thick top and sides
Printing Settings1) 100 % infill so that it is tough2) 0.3 mm layer height (if you are patient you could use 0.2  mm layer height 3)Printing speed depends on your printer4)No need for supports when printing the cap(with proper orientation)5) Need for supports when printing the case to help the button cutout come out great
Extra info 1) The case in the photos was printed a bit sloppy since i had not calibrated my printer well (The 2 patters come from overextrusion that i tuned in the middle of the print)2)BE WARNED : after regular use the fit on the cap gets a bit loose and it tends to fall off (i have used the case for about 3 months now) the case fit is the same being great ( i now do not use the cap to be honest at all)
I hope you enjoy the case as much as i do.

description_text:
• Let me present to you simple low-poly 3D model Apple iPod nano 6th Generation. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... •    Ease of use consists of one mesh, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.

• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
• Let me present to you simple low-poly 3D model Apple iPod Nano 5 Generation. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc... Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real player that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically.
•    Ease of use consists of one mesh, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• The total of the main textures is 1. Resolution of all textures is 2048 pixels square aspect ratio in .jpg format. 
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

It was the successor to the Nintendo 64 and predecessor to the Wii.        The Nintendo GameCube was the first Nintendo console to use optical discs as its primary storage medium, after several aborted projects from Nintendo and its partners to utilize optical-based storage media. In contrast with the GameCube's contemporary competitors, the PlayStation 2 and Xbox, the GameCube uses miniDVD-based discs instead of full-size DVDs. It also enabled connectivity to the Game Boy Advance to access exclusive features of certain games or to use the portable system as a controller for the Game Boy Player.        The console was released on September 14, 2001 in Japan, November 18, 2001 in North America, May 3, 2002 in Europe, and May 17, 2002 in Australia. The GameCube sold 21.74 million units worldwide.

description_text:
standard measuring tips for multimeters. 
Measurement is the quantification of attributes of an object or event, which can be used to compare with other objects or events. In other words, measurement is a process of determining how large or small a physical quantity is as compared to a basic reference quantity of the same kind.[3] The scope and application of measurement are dependent on the context and discipline. In natural sciences and engineering, measurements do not apply to nominal properties of objects or events, which is consistent with the guidelines of the International vocabulary of metrology published by the International Bureau of Weights and Measures. However, in other fields such as statistics as well as the social and behavioral sciences, measurements can have multiple levels, which would include nominal, ordinal, interval, and ratio scales.
A multimeter can use many different test probes to connect to the circuit or device under test. Crocodile clips, retractable hook clips, and pointed probes are the three most common types. Tweezer probes are used for closely spaced test points, as for instance surface-mount devices. The connectors are attached to flexible, well insulated leads terminated with connectors appropriate for the meter. Probes are connected to portable meters typically by shrouded or recessed banana jacks, while benchtop meters may use banana jacks or BNC connectors. 2 mm plugs and binding posts have also been used at times, but are less commonly used today. Indeed, safety ratings now require shrouded banana jacks.

Amazon Echo Dot 2nd Generation ready for use. Close to photo real. Light ring ready to be animated. The model comes default as black however it would be easy to change to white if you should choose to. Simple edit the material color and WHHAABAM you're done. And I promise, This is one echo dot that wont randomly start laughing like a witch in the middle of the night. 
Shortly after the Amazon Echo release, Amazon announced Alexa Fund in June of 2015, in which they invested in companies that made voice control devices. This fund ended up investing over $100 million in several companies that made products like the Amazon Echo.   Since the release of the Amazon Echo in early 2014 the company, Amazon, has developed many similar devices that they have released into the artificial intelligence and technological markets.   In March of 2016 Amazon released a byproduct of the Amazon Echo, called the Amazon Echo Dot. This device is essentially a hockey puck sized version of the original Amazon Echo released in 2014, and it has the same capabilities. This product was designed to be used in smaller rooms such as bedrooms due to its limited speaker capabilities (size) or to be paired with an external speaker. In November of 2016 the second generation of the Echo Dot was released for a lower price with improved voice recognition and new colors.

description_text:
This is a microphone stand for a small electret condenser microphone.You can self made microphone stand using the electret condenser microphone.
The dimension of a suitable electret condenser microphone is 6 mm in diameter and 3.5 mm in thickness (maximum 4 mm).[This kit requires you to buy an electret condenser microphone at another store.]
If the electret condenser microphone is small, adjust the gap with a spacer or the like.You can not use larger size than above.
ABS has toughness, therefore it is suitable for printing material of this model.Please set the printer setting to high accuracy mode. (0.1 mm is desirable)
[About assembly]

  - Solder the shielded cord to the electret condenser microphone and pass the cord through the body.(Use the code diameter smaller than 2 mm.)

  - Insert the microphone into the cap and at the same time bond(glue) the cap to the body.

  - Bond(glue) the attachment to the body.

  - After the bond(glue) dried, insert to the base plate. At this time, be careful as the fitting part is fragile. Peeling occurs when the adhesion of the material is insufficient in printing.

  - It is also possible to fix the cord to the base plate by cord stopper parts.

[Dimensions (unit : mm)]

  - H: 29, D: 29, W: 25 (Base Plate 1)

  - H: 59, D: 40, W: 40 (Base Plate 2)

  - H: 89, D: 50, W: 50 (Base Plate 3)

[Othe]I printed it using FLASHFORGE ADVENTURE 3. The product examples is polished and painted.
Thank you for viewing.

description_text:
This is a DIY solar tracker for maximizing sun exposure to the Ring battery operated camera's solar panel. It is completely powered by the Sun and is designed to follow the Sun from sunrise to sunset.No batteries are used, just solar panels, a small DC motor, pulleys and supports. The pulleys, supports and mounting clips are printed on a 3D printer and are available here for download as STL files.The lazy susan can be found on Amazon and the pulleys are connected with any type of elastic cord.  I used a sewing machine cord. The base is a round disc, 9 inches in diameter. It can be made of lighweight wood of even stiff cardboard. The device is not intended to be left out in the rain. I find that using it on a sunny day as the camera battery gets depleted is sufficient to bring the battery up to capacity. The Ring solar panel clips are designed for easy mounting of the Ring solar panel to the tracker and then to its normal resting base.
The YouTube link for building and testing is here:  https://youtu.be/KZGXwElk_YE

description_text:
A keypad/magnetic card reader designed to add security to any door/entryway. Place it on the walls of your home, office, warehouse, military compound, or wherever you wish to protect. Good for both interior and/or exterior security placement.
Add realism to your corporate, R&D, lab, warehouse, etc. virtual environments with our unique combination magnetic card reader and keypad. Wherever staff needs to obtain access, especially with either a pin code entry and/or magnetic stripe card, you now have the right model for the job. 
Note: While this particular model is 3D, our RAK1 asset pack (Off The Wall), includes this model - WITH AUDIO! Use the wrong card (card swipe audio) or enter the wrong keystrokes (key button audio), and you get an obvious No entry! sound. Use the right card or pin code, and you get an obvious You may enter! audio signal. Again, only with the complete RAK1 package, in the Unreal Marketplace. See it in action here: https://youtu.be/1nFmb_aOJaY .
The operation of this (virtual) unit is based upon the real thing: swipe your (virtual - not needed) key card through the magnetic card reader, which reads information from the card’s magnetic stripe, transmitting it to an access control unit (within). Typically, the keypad offers additional security, wherein the user’s card is swiped, and the correct PIN entered, before access is granted.
Designed to be a realistic, usable, commercial piece, with a metal housing & collapsible touch sensor keypad buttons, with industrial undertones, that will provide any environment requiring security with the most appropriate accent, for enhanced exhibition. 
This asset is part of Burnout Game Studio’s “RAK 1: Off The Wall” collection. BGS provides aspiring, as well as seasoned, game & VR devs with the experience they want, to get their dream industry job. An in-house development studio for Burnout Game Ventures, Roadside Assistance Kits (RAKs) are carefully curated asset packs, aimed at specific target markets.

description_text:
eBook reader 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 3622 vertices, 3613 quad faces (7226 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
It's a compact flashlight design created by robust compressed plastic with 4 powerfull fully detailed LED lights and has an optic glass and interior mirror to amplify the light. The model has been created in solidworks originally and then exported to*3Ds MAX* and materialized and rendered there, then exported to different format from 3ds max. The different parts include:

  - 4x LED Light Shells

  - 4x LED Light Plates

  - Amplifier Mirror

  - Optic Glass

  - Main Body (Hanlde)

  - Tip Part

  - End Part

  - On and Off Button

....... The model is rendered and materialized in 3Ds MAX and Corona renderer. If you have corona installed it should work all fine as soon as you open it, but if you don't I have included all the material assets you need and they are easy to make in any renderer. . I have tried to export the model in as many formats as I could, but if you need something specific you can get in contact with me and I will help you. . . . . . . 

If there are any problems please contact me
